self evidence

  • CURIE: gmeow:evidenceSELF
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/evidenceSELF
  • Category: individual
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/evidence

Evidence originating from the subject of the claim itself — a self-assertion, self-published biography, or press release. High authority for the subject's own standpoint (Principle 9), but low warrant for third-party verification.

Types: gmeow:EvidenceClass

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:evidenceSELF as a controlled value typed as gmeow:EvidenceClass.
